wins.text: Q4 diluted EPS of $0.99, up 50% versus prior year; full-year EPS grew 15%
Gross margins expanded 110 basis points to 44.7% in Q4, driven by strategic pricing actions, lower ocean freight rates and improved supply chain efficiency
Performance business grew double digits in Q4 across men's, women's, kids' and Jordan, across all channels and geographies, with basketball up double digits and fitness apparel up double digits
Full-year cash flow from operations was $7.4 billion, up 27% versus prior year; inventory declined 11% with continued improvement in days in inventory
Save-to-invest initiative unlocked ~$1 billion reallocation into consumer-facing activities for fiscal '25, including running ground game, design, sports marketing and brand campaigns

risks.text: Fiscal '25 reported revenue now expected to be down mid-single digits, with Q1 expected down approximately 10% — a significant cut from prior guidance of down low single digits in H1
NIKE Digital declined 10% in Q4 on softer traffic, higher promotions and lower sales of classic footwear franchises; digital headwinds expected to persist, especially in H1 FY25

Lifestyle business declined across men's, women's and Jordan in Q4, more than offsetting strong performance growth; planned aggressive supply reductions of largest classic franchises will create several points of revenue headwind in FY25
Greater China brick-and-mortar traffic declined as much as double digits versus prior year; macro outlook for China softened with promotional marketplace persisting
Foreign exchange headwinds worsened, now expected to create a 1-point translational revenue headwind in FY25, up from prior expectations

guidance_items.detail: FY25 reported revenue now expected down mid-single digits vs. prior guidance of down low single digits in H1 with growth expected; Q1 specifically guided down ~10%
FY25 gross margin expansion of approximately 10-30 bps on a reported basis; Q1 gross margins in line with full-year guidance
Full-year effective tax rate expected in high teens range; no explicit EPS guidance provided but SG&A guided up slightly for full year
H1 FY25 revenue expected down high single digits, with meaningful sequential improvement expected in H2
Other income and expense including net interest income expected at $250M-$300M for the year; SG&A up slightly full year, up mid-single digits in Q1

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Quantitative framework for second-half recovery (specific numbers on franchise penetration normalization and order book magnitude)
Long-term revenue growth model beyond FY25 and whether high-single-digit growth targets remain valid given structural shifts in China and wholesale mix
Timeline and completeness of the $2 billion cost reallocation program and whether organizational reset is fully behind them
